hero.tagline: I *bridge* gaps by inspiring confidence and engaging people.

items.alt: Deploying the underwater acoustic release system from a dock in Boston Harbor
Cutting steel with an angle grinder on the manufacturing floor
Lifting test for a 3-point lifting frame

items.blurb: Two terms supporting the poloidal field magnets for the SPARC tokamak. Designed a 2,100 lb lifting frame certified to ASME BTH-1, conformal fixturing for 11 cable configurations, and tooling that cut hours out of the insulation-wrapping process.

Circuit card production for missile and radar systems. Designed a composite fixture shielding heat-sensitive filters from 93 °C reflow, and ran a nine-configuration solder stencil study that reduced rework across 15 programs.
Liquid rocket engine team since 2023. Currently designing a servo-to-valve torque coupling and custom ball valve regulator for the feed system on our flight vehicle.

aboutSection.heading: Hi, I'm Ryan.
aboutSection.lede: I'm a mechanical engineer, focused on clean energy and aerospace.
aboutSection.bio: I'm currently working on a low-cost underwater mechanical release system for underwater robotic recovery for my senior capstone. I am also working on the feed system for a liquid rocket engine on Northeastern's Aerospace Club. I've previously worked as a Manufacturing Engineer at Commonwealth Fusion Systems, where I supported the poloidal field magnets for the SPARC tokamak.

items.title: Running
items.body: I love running! I'm President of Northeastern's Running Club. I've recently broken into longer distances. I've run a trail 50k and placed 800th overall at the Boston Marathon in 2026.

items.title: Music
items.body: I have a great appreciation for music. I played trumpet in high school, picked up guitar my junior year, and now play rhythm guitar in an alt-rock band.

items.title: Interior Design & Plants
items.body: I have always had an appreciation for small details, and I bring that into the spaces I live in. I also love flowers and plants!

contactSection.heading: We should talk!
contactSection.body: I'm always up for chatting about clean energy, aerospace, manufacturing, or design. Drop me a line!
